title: Character-arc grid artefact
description: Per-character grid of want / need / wound / arc-direction / scene-by-scene emotional trajectory. Used by character-driven paradigms (hero's journey, classic three-act with strong protagonist arc).

want.description: External goal the character pursues — what they consciously chase.

need.description: Internal lesson — what the character must learn or accept.

wound.description: Backstory injury or formative event driving the character's behavior.

arcDirection.description: Arc shape: positive (learns/grows), negative (declines), flat (changes the world without changing themselves), corruption (declines under temptation), redemption (recovers from a fallen state).

beatRef.description: Reference to a beatId in the corresponding beat sheet, or a scene number.

stateChange.description: What changes inside the character at this beat/scene.
